symptom: report all --run in an environment where the tests cannot run: tests AND traceability 'Not generated: open out/junit.xml: no such file or directory', though --journeys/--spans were given
cause: collectEvidence recorded the failed `mxcli test` as a warning but then failed the whole report reading the results file the run never wrote
insight: Evidence a report can stand without is a warning when it is missing, not an error: the error hid the real cause (the failed run) behind a file-not-found, and took the journeys down with it
